tools.name: get_estimate_requirements
tools.description: Start a conversation about a UK or US residential addition, conversion, kitchen, bathroom, remodel or new-home budget. Returns the country-specific choices, missing inputs and useful questions. No account or saved project required.

tools.name: calculate_guide_price
tools.description: Calculate a free indicative residential building-cost range using Proper Job's country-specific engine. Use country GB with GBP, square metres and an outward postcode, or country US with USD, square feet and a state code. Use only scope supplied in the conversation. Missing details return needs_inpu

tools.name: compare_guide_scenarios
tools.description: Calculate a baseline and up to three user-supplied scope alternatives on the same pricing policy, including server-calculated price differences. Supply baseline inputs from the conversation; saved estimates cannot be retrieved.
